verses.en: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: Isaraelu e tusa ma lo latou faitauina, o matai sili, ma alii o taitoaafe ma taitoaselau, ma o latou faipule e na auauna i le tupu i mea uma a vasega, na auaua'i i lea masina ma lea masina i masina uma o le tausaga, O vasega taitasi e lua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: Sa pule lasapama le atalii o Sapetielu i le vasega muamua i le masina muamua. Sa i lona vasega e toaluafulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.sm: O so le fanauga a Faresa, o le alii sili ia ia ilatou uma o e ave ‘au i le masina muamua.

verses.en: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: Na pule foi Toto o lo sa Aoki i le vasega o le masina E lua, sa i lona vasega o Mekelota o le alii. Sa i lona vasega e toaluafulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O Penaia le atalii o Ioiata, o le faipule sili, o le toatolu ia, o le pule i “au i le tolu O masina. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.sm: O Penaia lenei, o le toa ia i le toatolu sefulu, na pule foi ia i le toatolugafulu. Sa i lona vasega foi o Amesapata lona atalii.

verses.en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O le toafa o alii, o Asaelu le uso o Ioapo ile fa o masina, a o Sepetia lona atalii na soloai ane i ai. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toalima o alii i le masina e lima, o Sama o lo sa Eserá. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toaono i le masina e ono, o Ira le atalii o Ikesa le Tikoa. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: to O lona toafitu i le masina e fitu, o Helesa le Pelone o lo le fanauga a Efaraima. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toavalu i le masina e valu, o Sepekai o lo sa Usa, o lo sa Sera. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toaiva i le masina e iva, o Apiesera o le Anatota, o lo sa Peniamina. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toasefulu i le masina e sefulu, o Maarai o lo sa Netopa, o lo sa Sera. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toasefulu ma le toatasi i le masina e sefulu ma le tasi, o Penaia le Piratonu, o lo le fanauga a Efaraima. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O lona toasefulu ma le toalua i le masina e sefulu ma le lua, o Heletai o lo sa Netopa, o lo sa Otinielú. Sa i ai foi i lona vasega e toalua sefulu o afe ma afe e fa.

verses.en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.sm: O e na pule foi i itu aiga o Isaraelu; o le alii o sa Reupena, o Elisara le atalii o Sekari; o lo sa Simeona, o Sefatiao le atalii o Maaka;

verses.en: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.sm: o lo sa Levi, o Hasapea le atalii o Kimueli; o lo sa Arona, o Satoka;

verses.en: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.sm: o lo sa Iutā, o Eliu, o le tasi lea uso o Tavita; o lo sa Isakara, o Omeri o le atalii o Mekaeli;

verses.en: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.sm: o lo sa Sepulona, o Iesemaia o le atalii o Opetaia; o lo sa Nafatali, o leremota le atalii o Asareelu;

verses.en: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.sm: o lo le fanauga a Efaraima, o Hosea le atalii o Ase624 sau; o lo le vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, o Ioelu le atalii o Petaia;

verses.en: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.sm: O lo le vaega o Manase i Kiliata, o Ito le atalii o Sakaria; o lo sa Peniamina, o Iasielu le atalii o Apineru;

verses.en: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.sm: o lo sa Tanū, o Asareelu le atalii o Ieroama. O alii ia i itu aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.sm: Ua le faitauina e Tavita o i latou e lua sefulu o latou tausaga ma e ua le oo i ai; ana na fetalai mai le ALII na te faatoateleina Isaraelu e pei o fetu o le lagi.

verses.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.sm: Na amata le faitau e Ioapo le tama a Seruia, a e lei faaiuina; aua ona o lena mea na oo mai ai le toasa ia Isaraelu, ua le tusia foi le faitau aofai i le tusi o tala i le nofoaiga a le tupu o Tavita.

verses.en: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.sm: Na leoleo oloa o le tupu e Asemau le atalii o Atielu; na leoleo foi faupuega mea e ‘ai o i le fanua, ma aai, ma faoa aai, ma ‘olo, e Ionatana le atalii o Usia;

verses.en: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.sm: na pule Eseri le atalii o Kelupo i e na fai galuega i le fanua e galulue i le laueleele;

verses.en: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.sm: na leoleo Semi o le Rama i tovine; o Sapata o le Sefama na leoleo i fua o vine e tuu ai i mea e teuai uaina;

verses.en: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.sm: o Paalaanana le Keteri na leoleo i laau o olive, ma laau o sukamoru i mea maulalo; na leoleo foi Ioasa i mea e teu ai suáuu;

verses.en: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.sm: na leoleo Setari le Sarona i povi na tataa i Sarona; o Safata foi le atalii o Atalai na leoleo i povi i vanu;

verses.en: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.sm: na leoleo Opili o le sa Isamaeli i kamela; o Ietaia o le Marono na leoleo i asini;

verses.en: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
verses.sm: na leoleo Iasesa o le sa Akara i mamoe. O alii uma ia na tausi le oloa o le tupu o Tavita.

verses.en: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
verses.sm: O Ionatana o le uso o le tama o Tavita, o le faipule, o le tagata faautauta ma le tusiupu; o Ikielu le atalii o Hakemoni na i ai i atalii o le tupu;

verses.en: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
verses.sm: o Aitofele foi o le tulafale a le tupu; o Usai le Araki o le uo ia a le tupu.

verses.en: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
verses.sm: E aupito ane ia Aitofele o Ioiata le atalii o Penaia, ma Aviata; o Ioapo foi o le pule i ʻau a le tupu. O poloaiga a
